blurb: Skydive City Z-Hills is Florida's premier skydiving center! The 1 choice for skydiving Tampa, St. Pete, & Orlando for 30+ years. Offering Tandem, AFF, & Sport Skydiving.
extraNote: Their policy: deposit non-refundable after 24 hr, reschedule 48+ hr out to avoid forfeiting it. · Deposits are non-refundable after 24 hours and deducted from total balance on the day of skydive · In the event of inclement weather, option to reschedule without penalty · No shows or cancellations within 48 hours of reservation time will forfeit deposit · To reschedule (for reasons other than weather), do so at least 48 hours prior to appointment to avoid forfeiting deposit; if Skydive City cancels, no further deposit is required
